name: Koganei Chako
source:
A bright and energetic girl. She is like a small animal.

She is a goofy character. She often says things without reading the air.

She is good at making people feel at ease. Her favorite games are Otedama  and Kagefumi.
He is a bit old-fashioned.

Her previous life is said to be a ...... secret.

Her special skill is Shiritori.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
